annotations.text:
The four priority screens — top row.
Everything is built on DevDeck's real tokens, lifted from src/index.css: Segoe UI, the #0b0e14 / #11141c / #151923 surface ramp, the 52px rail with its 2.5px indigo active bar, 11–13px type.

Controls work — click them.
Feature Detail has 7 live tabs. The Context Inspector expands sections and toggles them in and out of the budget. Conflicts, Features and Activity all filter.

Supporting screens — second row.
Agents carries the permission matrix; Features has a working table/card toggle; Activity filters by event kind.
